character.name: Ysrian
character.background: Grovesworn Tether — Wild-touched scholar of forgotten woodlands, fluent in the voices of fur and feather.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.description: Whisper to the wind to sense weather shifts and natural omens.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: Touch a willing creature, granting them a +1d4 bonus on their next ability check.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.description: Grasping roots sprout to restrain foes in a 20-foot square, dealing bludgeoning damage on escape attempts.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.description: Illuminates targets in cold light, granting attackers advantage on melee rolls against them.

character.gear: Weathered leather armor · Ash-carved quarterstaff · Trail rations (3 days) · Vial of sunberry salve · Bone-and-bramble focus · Flint and steel · Hemp rope (50 ft)
character.story: Born beneath the weeping boughs of Oakhaven’s rotting heart, Ysrian learned that silence speaks loudest to the hunted and the hungry. When the Blight came, his clan vanished into mist and marrow. He walks alone now, trading whispers for survival, guided by a corvid that never left his shoulder.

inventory.name: Ash-carved Quarterstaff
inventory.lore: Split and hardened over centuries in the Ironbark expanse, its grain still holds the memory of ancient grove-wardens.
inventory.description: A sturdy branch split and hardened over decades of travel.

inventory.name: Leathers of the Veil
inventory.lore: Harvested from a stag that wandered the Salt Marches; the stitching uses sinew from the same beast to blend scent with the wild.
inventory.description: Stitched from shed hide and tanned bark cloth.

inventory.name: Trail Rations
inventory.lore: Pressed seeds and dried root-meat packed tight to outlast moonless nights in the Hollow Fen.

inventory.name: Sunberry Salve
inventory.lore: Brewed from the first bloom of the Cinder Glade, saved by a hedge-witch who bartered her life for a single drop.
inventory.description: A glowing amber ointment that knits flesh and burns away festering rot.
inventory.effects: Heals 1d4+2 HP when applied to wounds.

inventory.name: Bone-and-Bramble Focus
inventory.lore: A hollowed jawbone threaded through with living thorn-vines; hums when predators draw near.
inventory.description: Crystallized resin and bone, used to channel primal energies.
inventory.effects: Allows casting of druidic cantrips and rituals without verbal components.

inventory.name: Flint & Steel
inventory.lore: Smuggled from a fallen watchtower where the keepers forgot how to start fires before the Long Dark.
inventory.description: A notched stone and iron striker.

inventory.name: Hemp Rope
inventory.lore: Braided from river-reeds and cured in bog mud, strong enough to lower a body into the sinking pits without snapping.

inventory.name: Weathered leather armor
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.

inventory.name: Flint and steel
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
